svg.title: RepRap Mendel90 · source-scoped route diagram
svg.desc: Each row labels both endpoints. Dotted means GUESS across an unqualified interface, not a direct wire. Solid lines represent source-local two-ended references, not installed V2 continuity. OPEN has no conductor. Group bars are not individual wires.
svg.text: RESEARCH ONLY · no installed V2 continuity or electrical compatibility established
DOTTED = GUESS; adapter, levels, polarity and return unknown
PURPLE SOLID = source-local reference only; not V2 wiring
Contact schedule, not a mating-face view · OPEN / NC = no route · grouped branches do not specify individual conductors
X/extruder 20-way ribbon numbered cable cores → Mendel90 X-axis ribbon female 15-contact D-sub cable end · SOURCE REFERENCE ONLY
